task.question: What is the highest recorded temperature in Germany during the 2026 European heatwaves?
task.evidence: 27 June — 2026 European heatwaves: The highest recorded temperature in Germany is taken in Möckern-Drewitz, measuring 41.5 °C (106.7 °F).

answer:
The highest recorded temperature in Germany during the 2026 European heatwaves was 41.7 °C (107.1 °F), which occurred in Coschen, Brandenburg. This temperature marked a new all-time national record and was observed over a period of three consecutive days of extreme heat. 

FINAL: 41.7 °C in Coschen, Brandenburg.
